the pressure drop characteristics of the CO 2 flow in a mini-channel and a grooved mini-channel.
the pressure drop characteristics of a CO 2 mini-channel with and without microgrooves.
the effect of micro-grooving on the pressure drop characteristics of two-phase CO 2 flow in a mini-channel.

the micro-grooves in a mini-channel do not significantly affect the pressure drop.
